1.consolidated_definition: Pomelo, fruta comestible de la toronja, de cáscara gruesa, carnoso, de color amarillento o rosado, muy aromático, y del que se extrae un jugo un poco amargo.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Pomelo, edible fruit of the orange tree, having a thick, fleshy rind and a yellowish or pinkish color, highly aromatic, from which a slightly bitter juice is extracted.
